skills.trigger: Cria a conta e o Case Agent do projeto
skills.default_prompt: Use $account-case-setup para criar a conta e o projeto que vou conduzir no Maestro.

skills.trigger: Name and personalize governed agents
skills.default_prompt: Use $agent-identity-setup to choose names, emoji-avatars and ownership for my agents.

skills.trigger: Control Maestro health, updates and recovery
skills.default_prompt: Use $bcgos-operator to inspect and operate Maestro setup, health, update or recovery without turning the CLI into the normal work experience.

skills.trigger: Interview and research one project case safely
skills.default_prompt: Use $case-agent-setup to create or refresh this Case Agent with reviewed, sourced context.

skills.trigger: Build a bounded first-days plan from approved case scope
skills.default_prompt: Use $case-kickoff to turn the approved case scope into a bounded kickoff plan.

skills.trigger: Review supplied slide text for storyline and evidence risks
skills.default_prompt: Use $deck-review to review the supplied slide text without editing or generating a deck.

skills.trigger: Build one decision-led professional storyline and deck plan
skills.default_prompt: Use $deck-storyline to turn the approved case evidence into a decision-led deck plan.

skills.trigger: Consolidate daily and weekly professional memory
skills.default_prompt: Use $dream-memory to run or inspect the appropriate memory dreaming cycle safely.

skills.trigger: Registrar tarefas e entregas, preparar versão, criar checkpoints e retomar trabalho entre sessões
skills.default_prompt: Use $execution-continuity para registrar esta tarefa e criar um checkpoint para a próxima sessão.

skills.trigger: Structure a bounded interview guide from approved case questions
skills.default_prompt: Use $expert-interview-guide to structure a bounded interview guide from the approved case scope.

skills.trigger: Recover an explicitly requested past deck or work artifact
skills.default_prompt: Use $find-prior-work to search my private prior-work index for this explicitly requested professional artifact.

skills.trigger: Extract professional documents locally and safely
skills.default_prompt: Use $ingest-content to process this professional source through the approved local ingestion route.

skills.trigger: Apply the user's BCGOS communication and disclosure preference
skills.default_prompt: Use $interaction-profile to resolve my active BCGOS profile before responding.

skills.trigger: Prepara workspace, runtime e manutenção local
skills.default_prompt: Use $maestro-environment-setup para preparar meu ambiente Maestro e deixar o runtime pronto para trabalhar.

skills.trigger: Start a guided owner interview with quick or complete tracks
skills.default_prompt: Use $maestro-onboarding to welcome me to Maestro and start the guided interview with a clear choice between the short and complete tracks.

skills.trigger: Confere e repara runtime, hooks e Darwin
skills.default_prompt: Use $maestro-runtime-checkup para conferir se o Maestro está pronto e reparar o que for seguro.

skills.trigger: Guide safe setup, updates and recovery conversationally
skills.default_prompt: Use $maestro-setup-update to guide me through this Maestro setup or update in plain language, with helpful emojis and respectful adult analogies.

skills.trigger: Turn meeting notes into a reviewable closure packet
skills.default_prompt: Use $meeting-close to produce a reviewable closure packet from the supplied meeting notes.

skills.trigger: Extract decisions, tasks and follow-ups from meeting notes
skills.default_prompt: Use $meeting-to-work-items to structure the supplied meeting notes without creating tasks.

skills.trigger: Classifica a qualidade de uma mudança com evidência proporcional
skills.default_prompt: Use $qa-gate para montar um pacote de QA e separar pass, hold e indisponível.

skills.trigger: Synthesize bounded qualitative evidence into themes and implications
skills.default_prompt: Use $qualitative-analysis to synthesize the approved qualitative evidence for this case.

skills.trigger: Analyze bounded quantitative evidence with explicit assumptions and checks
skills.default_prompt: Use $quantitative-analysis to analyze the approved quantitative evidence for this case.

skills.trigger: Map supplied deck text into slide messages and a narrative arc
skills.default_prompt: Use $slide-summary to map the supplied deck text slide by slide without creating a deck.

skills.trigger: Migrate the retired workspace-agent setup name
skills.default_prompt: Use $case-agent-setup; this legacy alias only redirects existing callers during migration.
